description: Single major mistake (bible: a gap in the firebreak permits predictable spread). Plan A is followed, but only firebreak:01 is cut, so the strip nearest the trail keeps two trees (x 11..12). The forest fire crosses that gap onto the trail hedge at about S=930 (93 s) and creeps east along it, against the wind, keeping the trail closed to the end; the unprotected ridge hedge is lit from the forest's east neck at S=2007. Both wooded paths are closed at the end, so the path to the lookout is lost.
